book.name: Jon
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Jisas ghamberegha la kamwathɨ i wa weya ramae
Jisas i dage weŋgiya gharaghambu iŋa, “Tha hu gharelaghɨlaghɨ hu vareminja Loi na hu vareminjeŋgo.
Bwebwe ele ŋgolo tɨne woluwolu i ghanagha. Thoŋgo ma ŋgoreiye mbala ma ya utuŋa weŋga. Iya kaiwae ya wa gheko na va vivatharaweya lemi ghamba yaku.
Na kaiwae ya wa na va vivatharaweya lemi ghamba yaku, ne ya njoghama ya vaŋguŋga na weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi, the valɨvaŋga ne va yakuwe ghemi tembene vo hu yakuweva.
Hu ghareghare iya ghembako ya wareriŋako ghakamwathɨ.”
Tomas i dagewe iŋa, “Giyana, ma wo ghareghare aŋga u wa, na ŋgoroŋga ne woŋa na wo ghareghare kamwathɨna iya u reŋanawe?”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ghino kamwathɨ, dage emunjoru na yawalɨ. Mane regha i mena weya Bwebwe thoŋgo ma i mena e ghino.
Thoŋgo mbema emunjoru hu ghareghareŋgo, ambane hu ghareghare Bwebwe. E mbaŋake iyake na i ghaoko kaero hu ghareghare na kaero hu thuwe.”
Pilip iŋa, “Giyana, u vatomwe Rama weime na mbala valɨkaiwame.”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Mbaŋa molao ya yaku weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi, ko iyemaeŋge ambama u ghareghareŋgo, Pilip? Thela kaero i thuweŋgo kaero i thuwe Bwebwe. Buda kaiwae uŋa, ‘U vatomwe Rama weime’?

Ko mamba u loŋweghathɨ ghino inaŋgu weya Bwebwe na Bwebwe ina e ghino? Utuutuŋgike iya ya utuŋake e ghemi ma ghino ghalɨŋaŋgu, Bwebwe, iye ina i yaku e ghino, iya i vakatha kaiwoŋgike thiyake ghamberegha.
Hu loŋweghathɨgha iya yaŋake ghino inaŋgu weya Bwebwe na Bwebwe ina e ghino. Thoŋgo nandere, vakathaŋgiko ghamba rotaele ya vakathaŋgiko kaiwanji ma hu loŋweghathɨ eŋge.

Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, thela thoŋgo i loŋweghathɨŋgo, ne i vakatha budakaiya ghino ya vakathaŋgi. Ŋgoreiye, na ne i vakathaŋgiya vakatha laghɨlaghɨye, ne i kivwalaŋgiya thiyake, kaiwae kaero ya wa na va yaku weya Bwebwe.
Na budakaiya ne hu naŋgo e idaŋgu ne ya vakatha mbala lo vakathako e tɨne i vakatha gharɨgharɨ thɨ thuwe Bwebwe iye ravwenyevwenye.
The bigithan ne hu naŋgo e idaŋgu ne ya vakatha ŋgoreiye.
Jisas i dagerawe Nyao Boboma kaiwae
“Thoŋgo hu gharethovu e ghino, hu ghambuŋgiya lo mbaro.
Na ne ya naŋgo weya Bwebwe na i wogiya ghami Rathalavu reghava na ne i yaku weŋga mbaŋathɨ mbaŋalaoke.

Iye Nyao na ne i woraŋgiya emunjoru moli weŋga Loi kaiwae. Gharɨgharɨ mane thɨ vaŋguvatha e yawalinjiko na ghanjirathalavu kaiwae ma thɨ thuwathuwawe na ma thɨ ghareghare. Ko ghemi hu ghareghare kaiwae i yaku weŋga na ina weŋga.
Mane ya iteteŋaŋga na ghemi ŋgoramiya ŋgama theghetheghe; tene ya njoghamava weŋga.
Mbaŋa ubotu yambaneke mane i thuweŋgo, ko ghemi tembene hu thuweŋgova, na kaiwae e yawayawaliŋgu ghemi tembe ŋgoreiye e yawayawalimi.
Ne e mbaŋako iyako hu ghareghare ghino inaŋgu weya Bwebwe na ghemi inami e ghino na ghino inaŋgu weŋga.
Thela thoŋgo i wovatha lo mbaro na i ghambuŋgi iye i gharethovuŋgo. Thela i gharethovuŋgo, Bwebwe ne i gharethovu, na ghino tembe ŋgoreiyeva ne ya gharethovu na womberegha ne ya vatomweŋgowe.”
Amba Judas (ma Judas Isakariyot ŋgoreiye) i dagewe iŋa, “Ko, Giyana, buda kaiwae mbene u vatomweŋge eŋge e ghime na yambaneke nandere?”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Thoŋgo thela i gharethovuŋgo ne i ghambugha lo vavaghare. Bwebwe ne i gharethovu na ne wo menawe na wo yaku weime.
Thela ma i gharethovuŋgo mane i ghambu lo vavaghare. Utuutuŋgike iya hu loŋweŋgike ma ghalɨŋaŋgu, Bwebwe ghalɨŋae kaiwae amalaghɨniye i variyeŋgo.”
“Ya utuŋaŋgiya thiyake mbaŋa amba ghino weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi.
Ko ghami Rathalavu, Nyao Boboma, iye Bwebwe ne i variye ghino e idaŋgu, ne i vavaghareŋga bigibigike wolaghɨye na ne i vanuwovɨrɨŋga bigibigike wolaghɨye va ya utugiya weŋga.
Ya iteta gharemalɨlɨ weŋga, ghino wombereghake lo gharemalɨlɨ ya giya weŋga. Ma ya giya weŋga gharemalɨlɨ ŋgoreiya yambaneke le gharemalɨlɨ. Tha gharemi i laghɨlaghɨye na tha hu mararu.”
“Hu loŋwe yaŋa, ‘Kaero ya iteteŋga, ko tene ya njoghamava’. Thoŋgo hu gharethovuŋgo, valɨkaiwami hu warari kaiwae ya wa weya Bwebwe iye i laghɨye kivwalaŋgo.
Kaero ya dage weŋga e mbaŋake iyake amba muyai i yomara, mbala mbaŋa i yomara, ma hu loŋweghathɨ eŋge.
Mane ya utu weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi mbaŋa molao, kaiwae yambaneke gharambarombaro maiya i menamenake; ma valɨkaiwae ne i mbaroŋaŋgo.
Ko ya vakatha budakai Bwebwe i dage e ghino ya vakatha mbala yambaneke i ghareghare ya gharethovu weya Bwebwe.” “Hu rakayondo e mbaŋake iyake na ra rakawe.”
